none: PAS NLM-B268A4: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma issue of 330-340, possibly Trier mint, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted and mantled bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS] RO[MA]. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars above. In exergue: possibly TRS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 14.6mm, Weight: 0.76gms, die axis: 12
